verified.summary:
The scope check passed. feat/br-2026-10-05-copy-story/phase-1 resolves to cc02d6c, which is also the worktree HEAD. origin/main resolves to 7d39bff. The three-dot diff lists 20 files, 14 of them under app/. The newest two commits are run bookkeeping only.

I found no money or recording defect. The copy fee, the cash debit and the ledger row come from one `copyFee` local value in a single write path. All three sit after the actionId guard, problem(), the resting return and the stale-price return (scenario.dart:333-436), so a resting or failed copy writes nothing.

Survivors after merging duplicates:
- **HIGH:** Arena participation is shared between personas while receipts are per persona. "Joined Bull/Bear" can be shown to a persona who never joined, and it can contradict the active persona's own position. Reproduced in source.
- **MEDIUM:** The ledger can show "No fee credits yet" above a $5.00 copy row and a $5.00 Total, while the chip and Portfolio row that open it still show market credits only, under a stale "ledger's sum" comment.
- **MEDIUM:** The top bar and the Settings header still name maya.eth while the copier's cash is shown.
- **MEDIUM:** No test proves that a resting or stale copy writes nothing.
- **LOW:** Five test gaps and one token nit.

Nothing freezes at merge, so no survivor is must-fix-before-merge. The participation bug should still be fixed before the demo is shown with persona switching. I refuted no finding outright. Each was reproduced against the tree, and duplicates were merged: 1 with 10, 7 with 12, 8 with 11, 9 with 13.

confirmed.title: Arena participation is not keyed by persona, so 'Joined Bull/Bear' and the crowd count disagree across a persona switch
confirmed.location: app/lib/scenario/scenario.dart:136-146 (switchPersona swaps only cash/positions/openOrders/receipts) and :435-440 (participation write); app/lib/features/arena/arena_screen.dart:133-157; vista_battle.dart 'Joined Bull'/'Joined Bear' labels
confirmed.failurePath: Step 1: as the creator, join Bull on a battle. The fill writes a receipt with clashId and sets participation[b]=long. Step 2: Settings > Demo persona switches to the copier. receipts swaps to the copier's empty list, but participation stays as it was. Arena now shows 'Joined Bull' to the copier, who never joined. Scenario.joins counts only the active persona's receipts, so the crowd 'and N' drops by one on the same card. Step 3: the copier joins Bear, which sets participation[b]=short. Step 4: switch back. The creator's card now says 'Joined Bear' while her receipt and position are long. This contradiction only arises because this diff keys receipts by persona and leaves participation shared.
confirmed.fix: Derive 'joined' from the active persona's receipts: the side of the latest receipt with that clashId. Then delete the participation map, which removes the state rather than adding a fifth swapped field. The alternative is to add participation to Books, swap it in switchPersona, seed the copier with const {}, restore it in reset, and include it in scenario_test state().
confirmed.why: I read switchPersona, the participation field doc ('only placeOrder writes it'), the placeOrder participation write, and reset. I read arena_screen.dart, which listens to receipts and participation, passes joined: Scenario.participation.value[b.id], and builds the crowd from Scenario.joins over receipts.value. I read the VistaBattleCard labels. The spec keys cash, positions, open orders and receipts; participation is a fill-derived per-user marker and is not on the 'stay as they are' list. Findings 7 and 12 were merged here; 12 has the sharper failure path.

confirmed.title: Ledger shows 'No fee credits yet' above a copy-fee row and a non-zero Total, and its entry points under-report against it
confirmed.failurePath: Step 1: in a default build, list a market in-app. AccountState.listMarket sets listedAt = clock = chartEnd, and every seed credit is dated chartEnd minus 3 to 96 hours, so marketFees is empty. Step 2: switch to the copier and confirm a copy, which appends a copyFee row. Step 3: switch back and open the ledger. It shows the 'No fee credits yet' empty state with 'Explore markets', then COPY FEES 'Copy fee · @sam.sol · ETH $5.00', then 'Total $5.00'. The Portfolio 'Fees from your market' row and the Your-market chip that open the ledger both show formatCents(marketFeesCents), which is $5 less than the ledger Total. Both carry the comment 'The ledger's sum', which is no longer true.
confirmed.fix: Show the empty state only when entries and copies are both empty. Then either add one Scenario getter (market credits plus copy fees) and use it for the chip, the Portfolio row and the ledger Total, or keep the chip as credits only and fix the 'ledger's sum' comments.
confirmed.why: I read LedgerScreen.build: `if (entries.isEmpty) VistaEmptyState('No fee credits yet')` never looks at `copies`. Scenario.marketFees requires kind==credit and at >= listedAt. AccountState.listMarket sets listedAt = clock.value. The seed fee dates are in market_mock.dart:146-162. your_market_screen.dart:168 and portfolio_screen.dart:201 carry 'The ledger's sum' and render marketFeesCents. Findings 8 and 11 were merged here.

confirmed.title: Identity surfaces still say maya.eth while the copier's cash is shown
confirmed.failurePath: Step 1: tap Settings > Demo persona. The toast says 'Now acting as sam.sol' and the row says 'Copier'. Step 2: the Settings header right above still shows SettingsMock.handle 'maya.eth'. Step 3: on Home or Portfolio, AccountTopBar shows the hard-coded PortfolioMock.handle 'maya.eth' above a ValueListenableBuilder on Scenario.cashCents, which is now the copier's $1,000.00. The one surface that pairs a name with a balance names the wrong owner.
confirmed.fix: In AccountTopBar and the Settings header, read Scenario.activePersona.value.handle through a ValueListenableBuilder on activePersona, as ReceiptsScreen now does.
confirmed.why: I read account_top_bar.dart:25-60, which has Text(PortfolioMock.handle) next to a cashCents listener, and settings_screen.dart:181, which has Text(SettingsMock.handle). A grep shows only receipt_screens.dart and the new Settings row read activePersona. Findings 9 and 13 were merged here. I dropped finding 9's Portfolio 'Fees from your market' sub-claim as a design question, since the ledger is the creator's by ruling.

confirmed.title: No test proves that a resting or stale-price copy writes no fee and no ledger row
confirmed.failurePath: The code is correct today. Now take a mutant that computes copyFee and appends the ledger row (or debits it) before the `kind != market` resting return or before the stale-price return. A limit copy from the feed ticket, or a market copy on a stale symbol, then writes a copyFee row with no debit, which is the fail-safe class. The suite stays green. copy_story_test has no OrderKind.limit and no stalePrices. scenario_test's limit intents carry no sourceAuthorHandle. The feed Retry test (order_ticket_test:343-370) runs as the creator, whose copies never write a row, and checks only receipts after 'Price expired'.
confirmed.fix: Add two copier tests to copy_story_test. (1) copyOf(..) with kind: OrderKind.limit returns OrderResting, cash is unchanged, and copyRows is empty. (2) With Scenario.stalePrices.value = {'ETH'}, a market copyOf returns OrderFailed(priceExpired) and state() equals the state before the call.
confirmed.why: I read all of copy_story_test.dart. Grepping test/ shows OrderKind.limit and stalePrices only in scenario_test and order_ticket_test, and none of those intents carries a source author placed by the copier. TradeMock.stalePrices is {'AVAX'}, so no copy test hits a stale symbol by default. Findings 1 and 10 were merged here.

confirmed.title: Copy fees leaking into marketFees, or dropping out of the ledger Total, would go unnoticed
confirmed.failurePath: Mutant A drops `e.kind == FeeKind.credit &&`. The copy row has marketId = ticker.value ('MAYA' after the setUp listMarket) and at = clock, which passes the listedAt filter, so marketFeesCents absorbs the copy fee and the ledger Total counts it twice. Mutant B drops the copies.fold from the Total. Both survive, because no test reads marketFees, marketFeesCents or LedgerScreen while a copyFee row exists.
confirmed.fix: After the copier's copy in copy_story test 1, assert that marketFeesCents is unchanged and that copyFees.single.amountCents == 500. Then pump LedgerScreen and expect 'Copy fee · @sam.sol · ETH' and Total formatCents(marketFeesCents + 500).
confirmed.why: A grep of test/ for copyFees, 'COPY FEES', 'Copy fee' and FeeKind finds hits only in copy_story_test, which never reads marketFees or pumps LedgerScreen. The receipts_test fee tests use only credit entries.

confirmed.title: The Settings 'Demo persona' row and its 'Now acting as' toast have no test
confirmed.failurePath: Mutant 1 removes setState(Scenario.switchPersona) and keeps the toast, so the app reports a persona change that did not happen. Mutant 2 reads the handle before switching, so the toast names the wrong persona. Both survive, because every persona test calls Scenario.switchPersona() directly.
confirmed.fix: Add a widget test. Open Settings, tap 'Demo persona', and expect the toast 'Now acting as sam.sol', activePersona == copier and the row value 'Copier'. Tap again and expect 'Now acting as maya.eth'.
confirmed.why: `command grep -rn 'Demo persona\|Now acting' app/test` returns nothing. The current code is correct: it switches first and reads the handle afterwards.

checked: Scope is sound. feat/br-2026-10-05-copy-story/phase-1 resolves to cc02d6c and origin/main to 7d39bff. The three-dot diff lists 20 files (14 under app/), and the worktree HEAD equals the branch.

All seven spec test names exist verbatim. The six in copy_story_test.dart include test 1's name, which is split across two adjacent string literals that concatenate exactly. The seventh, r'copy review shows the $5.00 copy fee in the total', is in feed_order_ticket_test.dart.

Test 1 kills these mutants: copy fee debited twice or not at all (cash is asserted as copier seed - margin - fee - 500, independent of totalCents); totalCents dropping the copy fee; sourceCallId missing on the receipt (`receipts.single.sourceCallId`); more than one ledger row, or a wrong amount, counterparty or asset (`copyRows.single`, plus length seed+1); creator books touched.
Test 2 (cancel) uses deep state() equality both after review and after Cancel. state() now carries activePersona and both personas' books, so any write at review or cancel is caught.

Test 3 kills an insufficient-funds check that omits the copy fee. The fixture proves margin+fee <= 100000 < margin+fee+500, the test asserts problem()==notEnoughFunds, and it compares the full state().
Test 4 kills a bypassed actionId guard: same() receipt, cash unchanged, one position, one receipt, one copy row. The guard runs before every write (scenario.dart:334-340).

Own-author detection mutants are killed both ways. Comparing against PortfolioMock.handle fails test 1, since the copier copying maya would pay 0. Dropping the equality, or comparing against the copier handle, fails test 5, which also asserts feeEntries is same() as the seed.

Test 6 kills these mutants: reset forgetting `_parked = _copierSeed` (the copier's cash would read creatorCash), reset forgetting activePersona, switchPersona sharing openOrders or receipts (the copier would see seed orders or the creator's receipt), and a switch that mutates state (the round-trip state() equality). scenario_test's mutateEverything plus the reset tests independently cover both books.

Test 7 kills a review total computed from a different number than the stored cents. The reviewed paperFunds must equal formatCents(receipt.totalCents) and cash must equal the seed minus totalCents. receipt.totalCents is checked against margin+fee+copyFee. The filled sheet repeats both the line and the total.
home_screen_test's Max expectation ($12,462.53) kills a maxMarginCents that ignores the copy fee. order_ticket_test's 20520/$205.20 expectations pin the creator paying the $5 fee on kaito.eth's call.
The limit path never reaches _ReviewPanel (feed_order_ticket.dart:190 `_rest`), so the review copy line cannot show for a resting order.
notExamined: I did not run any test or apply any mutation, because I am read-only and the gate already passed at f9368e6. Mutant survival is argued from reading the code and grepping test/, not from execution.
The actionId guard scans only the active persona's receipts and openOrders. I found no UI path that re-confirms the same actionId after a persona switch, so I did not file it.

I did not check correctness outside test strength: sourceCallId uniqueness ('handle/ticker'), the copy row's marketId when the creator is unlisted, and identity surfaces that still show maya.eth while acting as the copier.

findings.title: Arena participation is not keyed by persona, so one persona's join shows as the other's
findings.location: app/lib/scenario/scenario.dart:436 (write in placeOrder); switchPersona at :138 does not swap it
findings.failurePath: Act as the copier. Open Arena and join Bull on eth-4k (a market fill with clashId). placeOrder writes participation[eth-4k]=long into the shared map. Switch back to the creator in Settings. The creator's battle card reads Scenario.participation.value[b.id] (arena_screen.dart:157) and shows 'Joined Bull' (vista_battle.dart:216), but the creator has no receipt for that clash. Scenario.joins() reads only the active persona's receipts, so the crowd count beside it ('and N', arena_screen.dart:135) leaves the join out. One card states a join the active persona never made and gives a count that disagrees with it. The same happens the other way round.
findings.fix: Add participation to Books and swap it in switchPersona; seed the copier with const {}; restore it in reset; include it in scenario_test state(). Or derive 'joined' from the active persona's receipts (latest receipt with that clashId) and drop the separate map.
findings.evidence: Read scenario.dart placeOrder (participation write after the fill), switchPersona (swaps only cash, positions, openOrders and receipts), arena_screen.dart:69-79, 133-157 and vista_battle.dart:214-226. Spec 09 lists only cash, positions, open orders and receipts as per-persona. participation is a per-user fill marker, not one of the 'stay as they are' items (likes, favourites, follows, listing, ledger).

findings.title: Your-market fees chip says it is 'the ledger's sum' but excludes copy fees, so it disagrees with the ledger Total it opens

findings.evidence: Read the marketFees/copyFees getters in scenario.dart, LedgerScreen's Total in the receipt_screens.dart diff, and the your_market_screen.dart and portfolio_screen.dart fee widgets. Both still call Scenario.marketFeesCents, and that now skips FeeKind.copyFee rows.

findings.title: The top bar names the creator beside the copier's cash

The balance is labelled as the creator's. Portfolio, which shows the copier's positions, also shows 'Fees from your market' with the creator's earnings. The diff moved ReceiptsScreen's 'own' check to activePersona but left these surfaces on the mock identity.

findings.evidence: grep for PortfolioMock.handle in lib/ outside scenario.dart; read account_top_bar.dart:25-60 and portfolio_screen.dart:225-250.

findings.title: No test pins the spec rule that resting and failed copies write no fee and no ledger row
findings.failurePath: The spec says 'resting and failed results write no fee and no credit'. The code is correct today: problem() adds copyFee only for OrderKind.market, the limit path returns before copyFee is computed, and the stale-price failure returns before any write. But there is no test with a limit-kind copy intent, or a copy on a stale symbol, that asserts cash is unchanged and copyRows is empty. If the ledger write moved above the kind check, or the guard were changed, no test would fail.
findings.fix: Add two tests in copy_story_test.dart. (1) Copier places copyOf(...) with kind: OrderKind.limit; expect OrderResting, unchanged cash, empty copyRows, and receipt-free books. (2) Copier copies a symbol in TradeMock.stalePrices; expect OrderFailed(priceExpired) and state() equal to before.
findings.evidence: Read all of copy_story_test.dart: its 7 tests cover a market fill, cancel, insufficient funds, a repeated actionId, own call and switch/reset. None uses OrderKind.limit/stop or a stale price with a source author.

checked: Scope: the worktree HEAD is cc02d6c, the same as feat/br-2026-10-05-copy-story/phase-1. origin/main resolves to 7d39bff. The three-dot diff lists 20 files, 14 of them under app/ (as stated).

problem() checks margin + fee + copy fee against cash (copy fee only for market orders) before any write. Insufficient funds returns OrderFailed and writes nothing. Margin alone is checked against cash first, so totalCents + 500 cannot overflow (notional is capped at maxNotionalCents).

placeOrder takes the copy fee in the same single debit as margin and fee: cashCents -= receipt.totalCents, and totalCents = margin + fee + copyFeeCents. The FeeEntry amount is the same copyFee local value. Receipt.copyFeeCents, the debit and the ledger row cannot disagree.

A ledger row is written only after a successful fill. Resting (limit/stop) returns before copyFee is computed. Stale-price and problem() failures return before any write. The creator copying another author pays 500 with no row; the manager ruled this out of scope for findings.

The actionId guard runs first and returns the first OrderFilled or OrderResting with no write at all, ledger included. Action ids come from a global counter that never resets ('act-N'), so they cannot collide across personas or resets.

A persona switch mid-ticket cannot happen in the UI: there is one root Navigator and no nested tab navigators, so the modal ticket blocks Settings. The simulation pill above the modal offers only Reset demo, which pops every route first. The review sheet's copy-fee preview and placeOrder's charge both read activePersona at the same moment.
The Portfolio open-order Undo cannot carry an order across personas: Settings' _say calls hideCurrentSnackBar, so the persona toast dismisses the Undo snackbar.
switchPersona only swaps values between the active notifiers and _parked; it never changes an amount. Switching there and back is identity (tested).

reset() restores both personas' books and sets activePersona=creator. scenario_test state() now includes activePersona and booksOf(p) for both personas, and mutateEverything leaves the copier active with changed books, so the deep-equality reset test covers the new state.

No new double money in the lane files: copyFee, kCopyFeeCents and FeeEntry.amountCents are int, and maxMarginCents uses int ~/. Feed ticket max with copy fee: a negative result when cash < 500 is clamped by _setMargin's max(0, ...).
No screen reads PortfolioMock.cashCents/positions or OpenOrdersMock.orders directly. OrdersState.open aliases Scenario.openOrders. Every cash, positions and receipts reader goes through Scenario.

Review baton R1 (any author's copy credits the creator ledger) matches the code at scenario.dart:419 and is the manager's ruling. R2 (the copier can copy maya.eth's call) is the intended copy-the-creator path, not a defect.
notExamined: Did not run any flutter test. The facts give a gate PASS at f9368e6 with identical app code; findings come from reading the source.

UI copy and layout in receipt_screens.dart, settings_screen.dart and the review sheet (design tokens, the exact toast text) belong to another lane; I checked only that the review and receipt totals match the stored cents.
Did not check whether the ledger is reachable before the creator lists a market. Copy fees are not filtered by listing, so a pre-listing ledger could show 'No fee credits yet' with a non-zero Total.

Did not cover the existing double-to-cent rounding at Max (marginCents is rounded from units*price), which can push a 100% stake 1 cent over cash. That predates this diff and is not specific to the copy fee.

findings.title: Ledger shows 'No fee credits yet' above a credited copy-fee row and a non-zero Total
findings.failurePath: Default build (no HAS_MARKET). The creator lists a market in-app: AccountState.listMarket sets listedAt = clock.value = TradeMock.chartEnd, and every seed credit is dated before chartEnd, so Scenario.marketFees is empty. The presenter switches to the copier and confirms a copy of kaito.eth's ETH call, which appends a copyFee FeeEntry. They switch back and open the ledger from Portfolio. The ledger renders the 'No fee credits yet' empty state with an 'Explore markets' button, then a COPY FEES section with 'Copy fee · @sam.sol · ETH  $5.00', then 'Total $5.00'. The Portfolio row 'Fees from your market' that opened the ledger still says $0.00, because it reads marketFeesCents. Copy rows also skip the listedAt filter, so a copy confirmed before the market existed still appears in that market's ledger.
findings.fix: Use the empty state only when entries and copies are both empty, or reword it to 'No market fee credits yet' when copies exist. Make the Portfolio row and the Your-market chip use the same sum as the ledger footer (market credits plus copy fees). Their comments say 'The ledger's sum', and that is no longer true.
findings.evidence: Read LedgerScreen.build (receipt_screens.dart:76-185): the `if (entries.isEmpty) VistaEmptyState('No fee credits yet')` branch ignores `copies`. Read Scenario.marketFees (scenario.dart:192-202): it requires kind==credit and !at.isBefore(listedAt). Read AccountState.listMarket (account_state.dart:17-22): listedAt = clock.value. Read the seed fees (market_mock.dart:146-162): all dated chartEnd minus 3 to 96 h. The clock is never advanced (only reset writes it). portfolio_screen.dart:246 and your_market_screen.dart:175 show formatCents(Scenario.marketFeesCents). This overlaps review-baton R7 (tile vs Total); the empty-state contradiction is new.

findings.title: Arena 'Joined Bull/Bear' and the crowd count leak between personas
findings.failurePath: As the creator, join Bull on a battle: the fill writes a receipt with clashId and participation[b]=long. Switch to the copier in Settings. receipts swap to the copier's (empty list), but participation is not keyed by persona. Arena now shows 'Joined Bull' to the copier, who never joined, and the crowd line 'and N' drops by one, because Scenario.joins counts only the active persona's receipts. If the copier then joins Bear, participation[b] becomes short. Back as the creator, the card says 'Joined Bear' while her receipt and position are long. A state label claims something that did not happen for the active persona.
findings.fix: Key participation by persona together with the other books: add it to Books and swap it in switchPersona, and reset the parked copy in reset(). Alternatively, derive 'joined' from the active persona's receipts (latest receipt with that clashId) instead of a shared map.
findings.evidence: In the diff, switchPersona swaps only cashCents, positions, openOrders and receipts. participation (scenario.dart:92) is documented as 'The side the user's latest fill in each Arena battle took' and is written only in placeOrder on a fill. ArenaScreen listens to receipts and participation and passes joined: Scenario.participation.value[b.id]. VistaBattleCard (vista_battle.dart:216-226) labels the button 'Joined Bull'/'Joined Bear' from it. Scenario.joins (scenario.dart:279-281) counts receipts.value only.

findings.title: Identity surfaces still say maya.eth while acting as the copier
findings.failurePath: Tap 'Demo persona' in Settings. The toast says 'Now acting as sam.sol' and the row shows 'Copier', but the Settings account header right above still says 'maya.eth' (SettingsMock.handle). Back on Home or Portfolio, AccountTopBar shows 'maya.eth' over the copier's $1,000.00 balance. Scenario.cashCents is the copier's, but the handle is hardcoded to PortfolioMock.handle. The one surface that pairs a name with cash pairs the creator's name with the copier's money, which contradicts the toast the user just saw.
findings.fix: Have AccountTopBar and the Settings header read Scenario.activePersona.value.handle through a ValueListenableBuilder on activePersona. The diff already does this in ReceiptsScreen.
findings.evidence: grep of PortfolioMock.handle/activePersona in lib: only receipt_screens.dart and settings_screen.dart's new row read activePersona. account_top_bar.dart:39 renders the const PortfolioMock.handle ('maya.eth') next to a ValueListenableBuilder on Scenario.cashCents. settings_screen.dart:181 renders SettingsMock.handle ('maya.eth'). The review baton recorded this as an unscored observation; I confirmed it in source.

findings.title: New review copy line hardcodes fontSize 14 and top padding 10
findings.failurePath: Feature code adds `VistaType.body.copyWith(fontSize: 14)` and `EdgeInsets.only(top: 10)` for the 'Copying @x · $5.00 copy fee' line, which goes against the house rule that design_system owns type and spacing. VistaTypography has no 14 pt token. This copies the existing row() helper at order_ticket.dart:909-915, so it carries an existing pattern rather than starting a new one.
findings.fix: Reuse the same TextStyle variable that row() uses (hoist it once), or add a 14 pt token to VistaTypography and use it in both places. Ideally use a VistaSpace token for the 10 px gap.
findings.evidence: Read the diff hunk and lib/design_system/tokens/vista_typography.dart (sizes 36/20/17/15/13/12/11/10, no 14). Matches review-baton R6, which I confirmed.
